newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CHH says well placed to meet Asian demand.
newsitem.headline: CHH says well placed to meet Asian demand.

text.p: Carter Holt Harvey Ltd Chief Executive John Faraci said on Wednesday that the New Zealand forestry sector was well placed to meet rising Asian demand.

"The New Zealand forestry sector is well positioned to meet growing Asian demand for value-added processed wood fibre well into the next century," Faraci told the New Zealand Investment Conference in Auckland.

Faraci said CHH had reshaped itself in the past five years from a manufacturer and distributor of a wide range of products, to a company focused on forestry, wood products, packaging and building products.

"This reorientation has enabled the company to capitalise on developing its world class plantation forests, develop new products for niche markets and increase its presence throughout the Asia Pacific rim," he said.

Faraci said CHH's "vertically integrated competitive cost structure, strong balance sheet and renewable asset base, flowing into added value processing, placed the company in a strong position to meet the growing demand being placed on the New Zealand forestry sector from Asia."
